title: Indoor room: chimney breast and two alcoves
summary: The projector-screen wall is a central projecting chimney breast with recessed alcoves on both sides; earlier rectangular and one-sided-step interpretations are superseded.
invariants: The 2.750 m and 3.750 m observations are not rectangle axes and do not imply a 1.000 m leftover span.
The chimney breast projects into the room; both side alcoves recess behind its face.
Unknown step/break positions and projection depth must be solved or measured, not guessed from appearance.

provenance.claim: Corrected room topology and metric roles.
